title: Primordial Paradox dialogue file
description: Every line the game can print, by dialogue id. A scene, a TALK command or a fight result names an id here. An entry carries its id, its speaker, and exactly one of `lines` or `pages`: `lines` is the one page shorthand that wraps by word (so only a WORD longer than 30 characters is refused), and `pages` is the pre-broken shape of spec 05 (1 to 3 pages, each 1 to 3 lines, each line at most 30 characters, because a page line is already one row of the box). A page may name its own speaker, which is how a mixed speaker scene keeps the right name plate. An entry may carry `sets` (flags applied when the box closes) and a last page `choices` (1 to 3 items of `label` at most 12 characters, `sets` of flags applied on the pick, and optional `goto` to another dialogue id). The numbers here mirror tools/check_data.py and tests/test_schemas.py compares them.

id.description: A dialogue id or a flag name: lowercase, digits and underscores.

line.description: One line as typed into the box, in the shorthand shape. No run of more than 30 non space characters, because the box wraps on spaces.

page_line.description: One row of a page that has already been broken: 30 characters is the box's line, so 31 is refused.

speaker.description: Optional. The name plate for this page; when absent the entry's speaker is used.

label.description: The panel is 96 pixels wide, so 12 characters is the column.

speaker.description: Who is talking, for the name plate. narrator is the no name case.
